column1: # Replay accounting of the committed demo tape of timerun demo 0
# 1c414e1b…, devilutionX e1ad0c2b6). Produced once from the tape itself by the
# same decoders the tests use (testsupport.parseDemoTape and
# game.DemoReplay.ReplayUpstream), cross-checked against a byte-level decode of
# the tape's first records: the KeyUp of SDLK_RETURN at offset 0x20, the first
# tick at 0x28 and the first motion (331, 314).
# cmd_per_tick:<n> = how many of the 14560 passes dispatched exactly n commands.
# FNV-1a 64 over the pass-ordered command counts (each as a LE32 word): pins
# the order the histogram buckets lose.
